changelog: Fixes from an outside read of 0.9.15. A message to a GitHub name with a hyphen now reaches that person, and /vibe no longer says "Sent" or "not in a session" when it could not confirm it.
features: A message to a GitHub name with a hyphen goes to the handle as /vibe spells it, so it reaches the person. The preview shows the handle used
setup --from now recognises an inviter whose GitHub name has a hyphen
A reply from /vibe that cannot be read is no longer shown as Sent. It is marked unconfirmed, and a prepared message offers the same text again or Cancel
"Not in a session right now" is said only when presence was actually read
A message that could not be checked during a network blip is checked again, instead of waiting for the rest of the session
An answer over an open line cannot be sent twice
Messages that named commands which do not exist now name the real ones
